column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT cl.id AS "id", cl.firstname AS "firstName", cl.middlename AS "middleName", cl.lastname AS "lastName", cl.display_name AS "fullName", cl.mobile_no AS "mobileNo", l.account_no AS "loanAccountId", l.principal_amount AS "loanAmount", l.principal_disbursed_derived AS "loanDisbursed", mo.id AS "officeNumber", CONCAT(sf.firstname, ' ', sf.lastname) AS "loanOfficer", (IFNULL(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived, 0)) AS "loanOutstanding", ls.installment AS "installmentNumber", ls.duedate AS "dueDate", ADDDATE(ls.duedate, ${gracePeriod}) AS "graceDate", DATEDIFF('${asAtDate}', ls.duedate) AS "daysPastDue", IFNULL(ls.principal_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0) AS "principalDue", IFNULL(ls.interest_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_waived_derived, 0) AS "interestDue", IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived, 0) AS "feesDue", (IFNULL(ls.principal_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.interest_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived, 0)) AS "totalDue", IF(ls.duedate < '${asAtDate}', 'Yes', 'No') AS "inArrears", gp.display_name AS "groupName" FROM m_office mo LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON mo.id = cl.office_id LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON cl.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule ls ON l.id = ls.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_staff sf ON sf.id = l.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN m_group_client gc ON gc.client_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN m_group gp ON gp.id = l.group_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = l.product_id WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND (${loanOfficerId} = -1 OR l.loan_officer_id = ${loanOfficerId}) AND (${loanProductId} = -1 OR l.product_id = ${loanProductId}) AND ls.duedate <= ADDDATE('${asAtDate}', ${gracePeriod}) AND ls.completed_derived = 0 AND l.loan_status_id = 300 AND mo.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ORDER BY ls.duedate ASC, cl.display_name ASC
